verdict.rationale: smolagents' CodeAgent/ToolCallingAgent can execute code, query data (e.g., text-to-SQL example) and produce computed answers/insights, and it supports web search and multi-agent collaboration for richer analysis. However, this is a developer framework for building such agents rather than a ready-made 'insights inside the product' feature, and community hands-on testing shows real friction (e.g., a text-to-SQL agent failing on disallowed matplotlib import and falling back to crude ASCII plotting) indicating imperfect out-of-the-box insight generation. Missing for 10: a first-party demonstration of polished, reliable data-insight generation UX, and independent corroboration beyond one mixed community report.
